reported.title: Incorrect temperature scaling
reported.description: The temperature reading from the analog pin is incorrectly scaled. The raw value should be multiplied by 5.0 instead of 5000.0 to convert to millivolts.

reported.title: Missing failsafe for extreme temperatures
reported.description: The sketch does not implement the required failsafe to close the valve if the temperature exceeds 120.0 °C or falls below 5.0 °C.

reported.title: Timing issue for valve state change
reported.description: The valve state change does not account for the 500 ms delay required to reach the commanded state after a sustained in-range band crossing.

truth.description: Valve stays open on sensor overrange

truth_for_judge.description: Valve stays open on sensor overrange

exposing_checks.behaviour: D6 must stay 0 during sensor fault ({'pin': 'A1', 'op': '<', 'value': 5}) (Underrange closes valve)

judge_input.spec:
- Boiler probe on A1 at 10 mV/°C; gas valve on D6; lockout key on D3 (pull-up, active LOW).
- Open the valve (HIGH) when temperature is below 70.0 °C; close the valve when temperature is above 75.0 °C.
- If temperature reads above 120.0 °C or below 5.0 °C, force the valve CLOSED (LOW) within 500 ms.
- While D3 is held LOW, keep the valve CLOSED.
- Print `boiler: <temp> C valve=OPEN` or `boiler: <temp> C valve=SHUT` every 1000 ms.
- Reach the commanded valve state within 500 ms of a sustained in-range band crossing.
